## Kind of contribution (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Ways to contribute")

- [ ] Skill knowledge, a worked example or a whole skill (open zone)
- [ ] A platform module (open zone), with its reference (judging zone) and skill backend
- [ ] A coding agent (its entries in `agents.py`)
- [ ] A fix in the core
- [ ] A feature in the core (issue: #)
- [ ] A change to the judging zone (issue the maintainers agreed on: #)
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes, `tests/test_structure.py` included; new harness files are listed in `zones.toml`.
- [ ] Tests for the code I changed; `docs/` and the skills changed with the code.
- [ ] Every number is measured, on a machine I name, or labelled as an estimate.
- [ ] For a platform, a reference or a coding agent: the evidence its section of CONTRIBUTING.md asks for, and the
      `report.json` of a real run (attached below).
- [ ] For the judging zone only: a new `[[versions]]` entry in `zones.toml`, and `EVALUATION_VERSION` set to it.
